decisions_requested.statement: Approve the established six-mode Activation cycle for OPI 7 and 8 in slots 037-048, without declaring the pedagogical template universal HNK grammar.
Approve slots 037-042 as drills of the validated two-part residence card, preserving VANI=WATCH with Master Lexicon meaning null, KUVAN/KUON=CANDIDATE, ON=GATE and no WITH lexeme.
Approve slots 043-048 as drills of EN KU VAMAVALA KE, preserving VAMAVALA=WATCH and the scoped EN KU X KE course interpretation.
Approve TRACE_GIDS as structural G-ID training only, with Candidate D drawings remaining PREPRODUCTION_NOT_OFFICIAL.
Confirm P04 is new SimpleWay HNK v1.1 authorship derived from validated OPI and is not reconstruction of the missing historical Activation payload.

explicit_non_effects: Does not create new HNK lexical forms.
Does not assign a recovered gloss to VANI.
Does not promote VANI, VAMAVALA, KUVAN, KUON or ON.
Does not create a WITH lexeme or global comitative grammar.
Does not universalize EN KU X KE.
Does not make Candidate D drawings official visual canon.
Does not promote any Activation slot to FROZEN.
application_rule: Do not transition Activation P04 to VALIDATED until all five scoped decisions are explicitly approved.
